figures.quote: Asylum support spend was £4.0 billion compared to £4.7 billion in 2023-24. Of this, £2.1 billion was spent on hotels in 2024-25, at an average of £5.77 million per day, compared to £3.0 billion spent on hotels in 2023-24 at an average of £8.3 million per day.
